name: lepons-cockpit
description: Lepons cockpit: SSH session management for Lepons nodes

scripts.dist:win: node build.mjs && electron-builder --win && node make-patch.mjs && node prune-release.mjs
scripts.dist:mac: node build.mjs && electron-builder --mac && node make-patch.mjs && node prune-release.mjs && for f in release/*.dmg; do codesign --sign 'Developer ID Application' --timestamp "$f" && xcrun notarytool submit "$f" --keychain-profile "$APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE" --wait && xcrun stapler staple "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.postinstall: node -e "for (const arch of ['arm64', 'x64']) try { require('fs').chmodSync('node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/darwin-' + arch + '/spawn-helper', 0o755) } catch {}"

extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Needed to connect over SSH to PCs on the same network (router).
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Needed to open projects in your Documents folder and let agents edit their files.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Needed to open projects on your Desktop and let agents edit their files.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Needed to open projects in your Downloads folder and let agents edit their files.
